selectedState: Use case:ui-mockup. 两个独立完整中文手机页面，A390px B320px，普通可读字号，真实正文纵向滚动与底部固定导航，不用手机外壳。样式参考1仅扁平白底、浅灰面、蓝色#4566c6、细边框、小8px圆角。保持DooKnow所有者宿主顶部汉堡/DooKnow/私人笔记，底部笔记/最近/收藏/应用/更多各自真实选中。图2起是现有内容参考。两页完整回收站内容，回收站tab在更多中被选中，顶部知识库管理/回收站/返回笔记，说明“笔记和文件夹均可恢复，保留原笔记标识；原位置被占用时，可以更换名称。”搜索回收站输入空placeholder按原路径或文件名查找；本页文件状态select全部状态、查找/刷新列表。全选本页可读取项目checkbox未选，说明本页3项·已选1项，恢复所选与永久移除所选文件可用（只选一篇可读取笔记）。列表3条，第一勾选“示例笔记”原路径00-Inbox/示例笔记.md，删除时间2026/11/4 16:00大小2.0 KiB；展开恢复时使用的文件名input值示例笔记-恢复.md和取消改名，提示“仅更改名称，仍恢复到原目录；不会覆盖已有项目。” 下方恢复并打开/更换文件名/永久移除文件。第二未选文件夹“旧资料”原路径30-Knowledge/旧资料，元数据文件夹·整体恢复、删除时间未知/大小未知，不伪造值；动作恢复文件夹/更换文件夹名，没有永久删除文件夹。第三“不可读取示例”原路径00-Inbox/不可读取示例.md，checkbox与恢复并打开/更换文件名/永久移除文件全部灰禁用，标暂不可读取。正文正常滚动，页尾上一页禁用/第1页/下一页禁用，真实保留说明“文件夹支持整体恢复，暂不支持永久移除。永久移除仅针对所选回收站原文件，无法在此恢复；历史版本、备份及必要的元数据仍按各自的保留规则保存。”三条列表长页可内滚动，不缩字号。A390/B320同字段与guard，按钮换行可达。

sourceContracts.title: Trash restore inline rename form

entry.trigger: 更换文件名/文件夹名 or NAME_CONFLICT result

permissionRules: Authenticated owner browser session; /api owner hook returns 401 if absent and 503 during maintenance. Mutations require configured Origin and CSRF token (apps/server/app.ts:141). No administrator/member role split is implemented for these owner surfaces.

locked=busy||pendingRequest||purgeDraft; locks selection/search/pagination/new restore/purge while operation or confirmation pending. Only available items selectable; folder restore supported, folder purge unsupported.

fields.name: 恢复时使用的文件名/文件夹名
fields.constraints: Empty/absent keeps original. Nonempty<=180 UTF-8 bytes; no U+0000–001F/U+007F / \ :; no leading dot/trailing space; not AGENTS.md. Notes require.md suffix case-insensitively; folders cannot use reserved _doo-assets. Remains in original parent; cannot enter a path.

actions.label: 恢复并打开 / 恢复文件夹 / 恢复所选
actions.guard: !locked&&!loading; all selected names pass validation; never overwrite existing destination

actions.label: 取消改名 / Escape
actions.effect: Delete rename draft and field error; restore trigger focus
actions.guard: Authenticated owner; current note/session guards apply.

importantStates: Name conflict automatically expands rename form
Cancelled hidden field no longer affects restore

hostContracts.scope: Complete owner shell only in complete main-page assets; this child uses actual parent metadata and a neutral local crop.
Complete owner shell only in complete main-page assets; this child uses actual parent metadata and a neutral local crop.

compositionRules.hostRendering: Complete authoritative owner/standalone host for full pages. Other surfaces use actual local component on a neutral background or only a small truthful parent cue; do not repeat full rail/sidebar/header. Large windows retain real title/close/body scrolling/footer.
compositionRules.incompatibleStates: Never combine mutually exclusive conditions into one apparent app screen; compact rows/sections are independent specimens.
compositionRules.captions: Source/title/role/state are recorded here as metadata; optional external labels never become product UI. Missing outer caption alone is not a functional failure.
compositionRules.legibility: Every field/action/row must remain readable at reference scale. Increase artifact canvas or split this job if necessary; never shrink or delete content to meet a job count.

originalManifestContract.geometryFamily: exact source renderer and field/action layout: WS-107,WS-109
originalManifestContract.generationInstruction: Read generation-execution-contract.md. Use actual template/role and selected baseline visible state before generic plan text. Submit a concise exact prompt for this one asset; full source/state/field/action contracts remain in this manifest and original plan. Draw independent labeled matrix rows/panels as specified, not incompatible states in one product page. Local component designs do not redraw full host. Full pages use their actual role-specific shell. Source-derived states are examples, not runtime acceptance. No invented features/inputs/buttons/permissions or fake saved/connected outcomes. Keep every existing visible action and actual disabled guard. Save full actual submittedPrompt and input responsibilities in SHA-bound sidecar, pending independent review.

verification.limitation: The tool does not expose a per-call model identity receipt.

submittedPrompt: Use case:ui-mockup. 两个独立完整中文手机页面，A390px B320px，普通可读字号，真实正文纵向滚动与底部固定导航，不用手机外壳。样式参考1仅扁平白底、浅灰面、蓝色#4566c6、细边框、小8px圆角。保持DooKnow所有者宿主顶部汉堡/DooKnow/私人笔记，底部笔记/最近/收藏/应用/更多各自真实选中。图2起是现有内容参考。两页完整回收站内容，回收站tab在更多中被选中，顶部知识库管理/回收站/返回笔记，说明“笔记和文件夹均可恢复，保留原笔记标识；原位置被占用时，可以更换名称。”搜索回收站输入空placeholder按原路径或文件名查找；本页文件状态select全部状态、查找/刷新列表。全选本页可读取项目checkbox未选，说明本页3项·已选1项，恢复所选与永久移除所选文件可用（只选一篇可读取笔记）。列表3条，第一勾选“示例笔记”原路径00-Inbox/示例笔记.md，删除时间2026/11/4 16:00大小2.0 KiB；展开恢复时使用的文件名input值示例笔记-恢复.md和取消改名，提示“仅更改名称，仍恢复到原目录；不会覆盖已有项目。” 下方恢复并打开/更换文件名/永久移除文件。第二未选文件夹“旧资料”原路径30-Knowledge/旧资料，元数据文件夹·整体恢复、删除时间未知/大小未知，不伪造值；动作恢复文件夹/更换文件夹名，没有永久删除文件夹。第三“不可读取示例”原路径00-Inbox/不可读取示例.md，checkbox与恢复并打开/更换文件名/永久移除文件全部灰禁用，标暂不可读取。正文正常滚动，页尾上一页禁用/第1页/下一页禁用，真实保留说明“文件夹支持整体恢复，暂不支持永久移除。永久移除仅针对所选回收站原文件，无法在此恢复；历史版本、备份及必要的元数据仍按各自的保留规则保存。”三条列表长页可内滚动，不缩字号。A390/B320同字段与guard，按钮换行可达。
